subject.facility_name: NEW HAVEN CENTER FOR NURSING & REHABILITATION LLC

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $146.63 per resident day (39.1% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 7.3% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $272,962, 4.0% of the $6,880,989 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,043,938, $22.25 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $489,746 (46.9%), allocated fringe $182,994 (17.5%), non-wage costs $371,198 (35.6%). Raw food was $330,880 ($7.05 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $1,555.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $569,784, $12.14 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $392,649 (68.9%), allocated fringe $146,714 (25.7%), non-wage costs $30,421 (5.3%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $149,937, $3.2 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $149,937 (100.0%).
Missing data: cost years 2017, 2018, 2019 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
